content: In Zephaniah, how does the LORD rejoice over His people?
explanation: He quiets them with His love. “He will rejoice over you with singing.” (Zephaniah 3:17, BSB)

content: In Zephaniah, where is the LORD your God?
explanation: He is mighty to save. “The LORD your God is among you; He is mighty to save.” (Zephaniah 3:17, BSB)

content: In Zephaniah, what great day is near and coming quickly?
explanation: Zephaniah warned of judgment. “The great Day of the LORD is near— near and coming quickly.” (Zephaniah 1:14, BSB)

content: In Zephaniah, with what will the LORD quiet His people?
explanation: He rejoices over them. “He will quiet you with His love” (Zephaniah 3:17, BSB)

content: In whose days as king did Zephaniah prophesy?
explanation: Josiah was son of Amon. “in the days of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah” (Zephaniah 1:1, BSB)

content: Who was the prophet Zephaniah's father?
explanation: Zephaniah was a descendant of Hezekiah. “the word of the LORD that came to Zephaniah son of Cushi” (Zephaniah 1:1, BSB)
